name: Phenix
source:
Is basically in a state of orgasm since he is strongly under Asmodeus' energy.

He is aroused by all external stimulus. In fact, he is even turned on by wounds that can kill so he is always at the head and conducts fanatical battles without playing it safe.

He is one of the devils that angels are most reluctant to fight against.
